text_copy_copy_copy.text: SPECIFICATION OVERVIEW

text.text: The Ortholoc 2 Small Bones Plating System with 3Di Technology features a versatile array of plating options that include low-profile fracture utility plates, 3 different 5th metatarsal fracture plates, and a pinch plate designed to facilitate distal metatarsal osteotomies, as well as fractures.

text_315864231.text:
• Versatile, low-profile plate designs are Type II anodized, pairing increased strength* with minimal construct prominence
  • The Ortholoc 3Di screw hole accepts either a 2.0mm or 2.4mm non-locking or polyaxial locking screw, addressing variations in fracture patterns and patient anatomies

text_315864231_copy.text: The Ortholoc 2 Small Bones Plating System includes a T-Plate ranging from 6 holes to 8 holes, Straight Plate ranging from 2 holes to 8 holes, 5th, Metatarsal Y-Plate, 5th Metatarsal Hook Plate, Jones Fracture Plate, and a Pinch Plate.

standaloneimage_copy.alt: Ortholoc Small Bones 5th Met Hook Plate

text.text:
Screws and instrumentation

The Ortholoc 3Di locking hole has been designed to accept 2.0mm and 2.4mm Ortholoc 3Di locking and non-locking screws. Surgeons can choose the most appropriate screw diameter and type based on anatomy, bone quality, and surgical goals.

2.0mm locking screws

  • On axis and polyaxial locking capability 
  • Cortical thread
  • 1.3mm Pre-drill
  • 8 - 20mm lengths

text_copy.text:
2.0mm non-locking screws

  • On axis and polyaxial capability
  • Cortical thread
  • 1.3mm Pre-drill
  • 8 - 20mm lengths

2.4mm locking screws

  • On axis and polyaxial locking capability
  • Cortical thread
  • 1.6mm Pre-drill
  •  8 - 30mm lengths

text_copy_copy.text:
2.4mm non-locking screws

  • On axis and polyaxial capability
  • Cortical thread
  • 1.6mm Pre-drill
  • 10 - 30mm lengths
